# Was the DoorDash outage on Nov 21 a cyberattack?

**Not established.** Not established. DoorDash has not given a cause or said anything about an attack. People on social media asked if it was a hack, but no one has shown evidence of one.

Incident: DoorDash app and website outage, Nov 21, 2026. Also reported as the DoorDash outage. First published Nov 21, 2026; last updated Nov 21, 2026, 1:17 PM ET.

> **Not verified: initial investigation only.** Nothing on this page is absolutely confirmed. It is an early look based only on publicly available sources, and it should not be treated as verified fact. Even items labeled "Confirmed" only mean a public source reports them. Made for entertainment using AI. Not endorsed by DoorDash, any government agency, news outlet, company, or anyone else named.

This is the current answer, not a final verdict.

## The latest

Nov 21, 2026, 1:17 PM ET: **DoorDash's Nov 21 outage has no stated cause; a hack is only social-media speculation.** First draft. 6 sources (1 Tier 1 not readable by us, 3 Tier 2, 2 Tier 3), 11 claims (1 Confirmed, 4 Reported, 1 Unverified, 5 Not established), 5 questions. The status page, Men's Journal and IsDown agree on the 11:30 Drive incident and 11:50 recovery. status.doordash.com could not be opened by our fetch and Men's Journal returned an access block, so their content was read through the IsDown mirror and search-result text; both are marked blocked. The hack claim is Unverified: only a social-media question quoted by Hindustan Times. No cause, post-incident report, resolution time or user count found. Outlets disagree on the Downdetector figure and start time; both are noted. Privacy check done: no names of people, no handles, no contact details.

## At a glance

- Status: monitoring
- Size: Large. DoorDash is a food-delivery service that many people use daily, and Downdetector logged more than 12,700 reports. DoorDash has not said how many customers were affected, and Downdetector counts reports, not users.
- Who is affected: People who use the DoorDash app or website, mostly in the US, from about 11 AM ET on Saturday, Nov 21, and businesses using DoorDash Drive from 11:30 AM ET. When the problem fully ended is not confirmed.

| Value | What | Detail |
|---|---|---|
| 12,700+ | Downdetector reports | User-submitted, not customers affected |
| 11:30 AM | First status-page entry (ET) | Drive endpoint errors |
| 11:50 AM | Recovery update (ET) | On the Drive incident |

### Known so far

- DoorDash's status page showed an increase in errors on its Drive endpoints from 11:30 AM ET on Nov 21 and a recovery update at 11:50 AM ET, per two outlets relaying it.

### Not known yet

- What caused the outage. DoorDash has not said.
- Whether it was a cyberattack. DoorDash has not said either way; the hack idea is only social-media speculation.
- Whether the Drive incident caused the app and website errors, and when the customer-facing problem ended.
- How many customers were affected.

## What we checked and did not find

We looked for these and did not find them as of the time of this page's first draft.

- A DoorDash post-incident report or statement giving the cause.
- Any DoorDash statement about a cyberattack, in either direction.
- A Resolved update on either status-page incident. The last update we saw was the 11:50 AM ET recovery note on the Drive incident.
- DoorDash's own wording for the second incident; the status page could not be opened by our fetch.
- Any statement from a regulator, CISA or an outside investigator.
- A number of affected customers. Downdetector counts reports, not people.
- Any claim of responsibility or credible claim of a hack.
- A link to other outages this month.

Some coverage says DoorDash had not acknowledged the outage. The status page entries relayed by Men's Journal and IsDown show it had.
